title: Women, Business and the Law 2026: law, enforcement, and perception
discussion_signal: The post emphasizes that legal rights matter only when institutions, services, and finance translate them into economic participation. This supports a lived-experience reading in which perceived fairness and trust depend on the distance between formal rules and actual access.
linked_research_question: How does the gap between gender law, institutional practice, and lived perception shape trust, agency, and participation?
limits: Institutional framing rather than direct lived-experience testimony
